newsitem.title: KENYA: Nairobi bourse index edges up, market mixed.
newsitem.headline: Nairobi bourse index edges up, market mixed.

text.p: The Nairobi Stock Exchange 20-share index edged marginally on revived local demand for inexpensive shares, bourse officials said.
The index gained 20.79 points to close at 3274.15. Turnover was posted at 11.940 million shillings on 412,161 shares from 13.962 million shillings on 351,998 shares on Monday.
Standard Newspapers traded at 12.25 from 12.05 while Diamond Trust Kenya edged to 29.75 from 29.
Credit Finance Corporation Bank closed at 18.80 from 18.75 while National Bank of Kenya eased to 15.50 from 16.
Dealers saw the market as being very quiet.
There was foreign demand for selected shares with National Industrial Credit at 50 unchanged and Kenya Commercial Bank at 76.50 from 77.50.
Brokers said they expected the market to continue mixed with a majority of shares easing except where there was foreign demand. "Prices have to go down. There is no demand," one said.
Kenya Power & Lighting was unchanged at 122 while Total Kenya closed at 63 unchanged.
Brooke Bond gained a shilling to close at 123 while Rea Vipingo eased to 9 from 9.15.
Sasini Tea & Coffee traded at 76 from 76.50.
